correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the piecewise-rational expectile equation αE(X-e)+=(1-α)E(e-X)+ for the rational three-point X and four-point Y. The complete parameter partition at 1/104,2/11,210/859 yields four exact positive differences s2_Y−s2_X, certified by positive coefficients, a negative quadratic discriminant, increasing-positive quadratic and constant 9/50. Independent exact Fraction stop-loss arithmetic gives mean/MAD standardized S_X(4/5)=1/5 and S_Y(4/5)=73441/569900, gap 40539/569900>0. Smoothing by narrow triangular kernels plus ε of uniform full-interval density converges in W1; monotone-root stability on compact α subintervals and endpoint limits at 0 and 1/2 make the full positive profile gap persist. No explicit numerical smoothing ε upper bound is asserted.
residual_risks: Uniform near-endpoint continuity of the normalized expectile profile requires the stated mean-gap condition and positive endpoint masses; the proof is qualitative in ε, not a numerical certificate for a chosen ε.
